integrity: Mathematical proof and standalone diagnostic checks provided. No external expert/independent certification, or independent audit, is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Positive weights and three pairwise perpendicular round coordinate disks only; no oblique orientations, elliptical disks, or degenerate weights. The inradius and support function are known ingredients rather than novelty. Mathematical priority remains provisional; equivalent morphological-erosion descriptions may predate this result.
title: Rectangular and rounded-rectangle inball centers of weighted coordinate discotopes
